title: Clear Ledger Filters in Ledgers
description: Answer: How do I clear ledger filters? This is the canonical Ledgers workflow for clear-ledger-filters.
prerequisites: You are signed in as accountant and can access Ledgers.
Route /accounting/ledgers is reachable and module data is loaded without blocking errors.
Required records and permissions for clear-ledger-filters are available before execution.
steps: Verify active workspace/company context before running clear ledger filters.
Open the exact workflow action labeled for clear ledger filters.
Enter required fields for clear ledger filters (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute clear ledger filters with explicit confirmation in the UI.
Apply filter controls first, then confirm table/list result counts change.
Validate result rows/totals/artifacts on the same page before navigating away.
If output is generated (report, export, invoice, or link), verify it is accessible and associated with the same context.
Record resulting reference IDs or filenames for traceability and follow-up.
validations: The clear-ledger-filters action completes without permission or validation errors.
Resulting state is visible immediately in Ledgers lists, metrics, or related output panels.
Output artifacts remain linked to the same entity/date context used during execution.
commonErrors: No data returned because filter/date/entity scope is missing or inconsistent.
Action appears successful but output record is not persisted or linked.
recovery: Reopen /accounting/ledgers, reapply field values, and rerun clear-ledger-filters with a narrowed scope.
Refresh session and confirm role permissions for accountant before retry.
Cross-check logs/output panes and relink missing artifacts to the correct context.

faq.question: How do I clear ledger filters?
faq.answer: Open Ledgers at /accounting/ledgers, run clear ledger filters with required selections, and validate table/list + output artifacts before closing.

faq.question: How do I troubleshoot clear ledger filters if results are missing?
faq.answer: Recheck filters, dates, selected entities, and permissions; rerun and confirm row counts/totals update in place.
